resources.string: Step 1: download the speech and translation models. You only do this once. Wi-Fi is recommended.
Ready. Tap Start, then play a Japanese video or stream in another app.
Microphone permission was denied. Android needs it to capture playback audio. Tap Start and allow it.
Screen capture request was cancelled. Tap Start and choose \"Start now\".
English subtitles (with the Japanese underneath) will appear here.
Tip: text appears a second or two after someone stops talking. You can long-press the text to copy it.
